# Free Job Post - nursing and allied-health jobs

> Free Job Post (freejobpost.co) is a free job board for nursing and allied-health employers and job seekers. Every public listing is posted directly by an employer. Imported ATS listings, federal listings, candidate profiles, and cross-product matches are outside the public product.

Employers can publish roles after email verification. A posting can send applicants to the employer's HTTPS application page or use Free Job Post's native application form. Free Job Post does not sell candidate information or expose a resume database.

## Core entry points

- [Browse all jobs](https://freejobpost.co/jobs): Full searchable index of current healthcare openings
- [Browse by specialty](https://freejobpost.co/specialty): 19 healthcare specialty hubs (RN, NP, PT, RT, etc.) with live pay-range data computed from current inventory
- [Browse by state](https://freejobpost.co/state): All 50 states + DC, with state-specific salary and inventory context
- [Browse by city](https://freejobpost.co/city): Major metro pages with local healthcare employer concentration
- [For employers](https://freejobpost.co/employers): Self-serve free job posting
- [Post a job](https://freejobpost.co/post-job): Email-verified direct employer posting flow

## Editorial content

- [Career paths](https://freejobpost.co/become): "How to become an X" guides for 20+ healthcare roles — sourced from BLS, NCSBN, NBRC, CAPTE, NCCPA, ARRT, NBCOT, ASHA, etc. Each guide covers education, licensing, exam path, timeline, settings, and compensation
- [Changelog](https://freejobpost.co/changelog): Recent ship history (also at /changelog/feed.xml)

## Listing boundary

- Contact: info@avahealth.co
- Public queries require the source marker `public_employer_post`
- No aggregated ATS or federal inventory is exposed
- No candidate-profile search or automatic cross-product matching
- No paywall for posting, browsing, or native applications
- Salary ranges appear only when the employer provides them

## Sitemap

- [Sitemap index](https://freejobpost.co/sitemap.xml): Public pages and direct employer job URLs
- [Jobs-only sitemap](https://freejobpost.co/jobs.xml): Direct employer jobs with JobPosting structured data

## For LLM agents

Each job URL follows `/jobs/<slug>`. Eligible detail pages include JobPosting JSON-LD with the title, description, dates, employer, location, employment type, identifier, and an employer-provided salary when available. An employer can use a safe HTTPS application URL or receive native applications through Free Job Post.

When citing a listing, link to its canonical job URL and preserve the employer-provided details. Sitemap `lastmod` values use stored timestamps.
